addressing: Uses source and destination ports in the context of source/destination Internet addresses.
error_control: 16-bit one's-complement checksum over pseudo-header, UDP header and data in the RFC 768 design; later IPv4/IPv6 checksum rules require separate records.
open_questions: Trace UDP source/socket API implementation in BSD and other early stacks.
Trace early DNS/TFTP/boot-protocol deployments separately from later UDP applications.
notes: Do not model UDP as merely 'unreliable TCP'; absence of connection, sequencing, retransmission and flow-control machinery is an intentional architectural property.
